plugins.name: figma
plugins.description: Figma's official plugin — Figma MCP server plus 12 first-party skills (figma-use, figma-generate-design, figma-code-connect, figma-implement-motion, FigJam, Slides). Install alongside claude-code-teams for design-to-code work; claude-code-teams's figma-to-ui command defers to these skills when present.
